bundle.shortDescription: Settings and battery level for the Attack Shark X11 mouse
bundle.longDescription: An unofficial app for the Attack Shark X11 mouse: DPI stages, polling rate, lighting, button mapping, sleep timers and debounce, with the battery level in the tray and low-battery alerts.
